items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mark Murphy was one of the 13 singers we hired to do Sing a Song of Basie.

ctx.x: Mark Murphy was one of the 13 singers we hired to do Sing a Song of Basie. His eyes were always like this at what we were doing. He wasn’t particularly a jazz singer then. He had been an accountant, I think. He was amazed at the whole thing. He would come down to the house every day. Even when we had no rehearsals, he would be there. From what we were doing, and from just listening to Dave and I talk, and then me talking to him, he became a jazz singer, and he’s never turned his back. I’ve got the greatest…
I make it a point to always see him as well.
